speedrunSeason2.description: Independent settings for E1N1 through E9N9. Initial spawn and periodic Invaders are connected; other rules arrive in subsequent steps. Deposit and power bank switches remain global under speedrun.

invaders.description: Whether periodic Invader generation runs in the season-2 block. Does not remove existing Invaders or disable Source Keepers or manual Invader requests.

ruins.description: Whether destroyed structures in the season-2 block leave ruins.

respawnCleanup.description: Whether season-2 respawn clears all artificial buildings and construction sites in its block. Player respawn itself remains global.

raceBrackets.description: Tick offsets after a successful season-2 landing at which results are captured. An empty list disables scoring.

respawnAfter.description: Run duration in ticks before automatic respawn. Zero or less disables automatic respawn.

claimController.description: Whether creeps in the season-2 block may claim other controllers.
